summary: Achieving financial success in commerce requires a powerful combination of **relentless determination and high-level capability**, because while favorable circumstances certainly play a role, true achievement is built upon a foundation of **sustained preparation and persistent effort**. Although spontaneous breakthroughs and fortuitous encounters can dramatically alter a person's trajectory, individuals must actively build their expertise and **endure years of foundational grinding** in order to capitalize on those rare, defining moments when they finally arrive. Furthermore, effective entrepreneurship often demands that leaders dive directly into daily operations to fix systemic flaws rather than remaining entirely detached from the hands-on work. Ultimately, lasting prosperity is forged by those who possess the **grit to seize critical opportunities** and the operational mastery required to navigate complex business challenges firsthand.
